verdict.rationale: Python instrumentation is clearly documented through a modular Python SDK, auto_instrument=True zero-config tracing, and @tracer decorators for manual spans. JS/TS instrumentation is only implied: Phoenix lists auto-instrumentation for the TypeScript frameworks Mastra and Vercel AI SDK, and setup runs through an npm CLI. The TypeScript SDK in the pack is documented for evaluations, not tracing. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented official JS/TS tracing SDK with manual instrumentation APIs, and independent hands-on corroboration of JS/TS instrumentation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: Phoenix's Python SDK is modular by design, allowing you to install only what you need.
Zero-config tracing — Enable `auto_instrument=True` to automatically trace AI libraries
Tracing decorators — @tracer.chain, @tracer.tool, and more for manual instrumentation
provides auto-instrumentation for popular frameworks (LlamaIndex, LangChain, DSPy, Mastra, Vercel AI SDK)
run `npx -y @arizeai/phoenix-cli setup` from your app's root directory.
